units.source_text: 盲人用棍子顶端戳着地面，歪歪扭扭地走到他们跟前。

en.t: The blind man tapped the ground with the tip of his stick and staggered up to them.

units.source_text: 可是他踏上桥板时，便将棍子扛在左肩上，右手扶着栏杆探索着，好像钢索车似的滑过桥去。

en.t: But when he stepped onto the planks of the bridge, he hoisted the stick onto his left shoulder, felt his way along the railing with his right hand, and glided across the bridge like a cable car.
